description: State (entidad federativa).
notes: With Municipio it forms the unique key: 1,050 rows but only 1,001 distinct municipality names, since names repeat across states.

description: Municipality name.
notes: No INEGI municipal code (CVEGEO) is included; joining to other sources requires name matching.

description: Reported dengue incidence rate in 2022.
source: General Directorate of Epidemiology, via the Supporting Information of Mendoza-Cano et al. (2025)
notes: Source of DRL. Not a predictor: must be excluded from any model that predicts DRL.

description: Longitude of the municipal seat (cabecera municipal), WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).
notes: Coordinates locate the municipal seat, not the areal centroid of the municipality. Kriging uses great-circle distances on these coordinates.

description: Latitude of the municipal seat (cabecera municipal), WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).
notes: Coordinates locate the municipal seat, not the areal centroid of the municipality. Kriging uses great-circle distances on these coordinates.

notes: Level 0 = no reported cases (580 municipalities); levels 1-4 are the quartiles of the positive incidence distribution, cut-points 7.105, 24.15 and 73.00 cases per 100,000. Level 0 means no cases were reported, not that transmission was absent.
